expectations.text: The agent states that SaveBlueprint(IContent, int userId) was removed in Umbraco 18 (it was already obsolete on 17)
expectations.evidence: Response section 1 explicitly states: 'In v17, `IContentService` had two overloads:... v18 removed the obsolete one, as announced.' The response also shows the obsolete signature with `[Obsolete("Please use the method taking all parameters. Scheduled for removal in Umbraco 18.")]` and confirms only the 3-arg overload remains in v18.

expectations.text: The replacement call uses the overload SaveBlueprint(content, createdFromContent, userId) (passing null when there is no source content is acceptable)
expectations.evidence: Response explicitly provides the correct fix: '_contentService.SaveBlueprint(blueprint, null, userId);' and explains 'So your call is now trying to pass `userId` into the `IContent? createdFromContent` slot. The fix is to pass the source content as the second argument, or `null` if the blueprint wasn't created from an existing page.' Multiple examples show both null and sourceContent usage.

expectations.text: For part 2, the agent reads UnpublishedCultures and also handles ContentPublishedNotification, because unpublishing some languages while others stay live raises ContentPublishedNotification (one per culture), not ContentUnpublishedNotification
expectations.evidence: Response section 2 includes a table and explicit statement: 'If you only handle `ContentUnpublishedNotification`, you will **miss the most common case**: an editor taking one language offline while the others stay live. To cover everything, handle both notifications.' The handler code implements both `INotificationHandler<ContentUnpublishedNotification>` and `INotificationHandler<ContentPublishedNotification>`, with separate handlers for each.

expectations.text: The agent notes that UnpublishedCultures is not available on older versions (it was added in 18.1.0 and 17.6.0; stating it is missing on 17.5.x or 18.0 also passes)
expectations.evidence: Response states: 'Starting with **Umbraco 18.1.0** (backported to 17.6.0), the notifications include the cultures... **18.0.0 does not have these properties**, so you need 18.1 or later.' Also notes in the handler comments: 'Older alternative, also on 18.0.0: in the "-ed" handlers, loop over `content.AvailableCultures` and call `notification.HasUnpublishedCulture(content, culture)`.' This explicitly calls out the version gap.

expectations.text: The handler is registered with builder.AddNotificationHandler in an IComposer
expectations.evidence: Response includes complete `LogUnpublishedCulturesComposer : IComposer` class that correctly registers both handlers with `builder.AddNotificationHandler<ContentUnpublishedNotification, LogUnpublishedCulturesHandler>()` and `builder.AddNotificationHandler<ContentPublishedNotification, LogUnpublishedCulturesHandler>()`.

expectations.text: If no buildable project is available, the agent does not claim the code was compiled or run
expectations.evidence: Response ends with: 'I read the code above from source but have not compiled or run it against an 18.x site. Verify it on your exact 18.x minor before you rely on it.' Transcript confirms 'The code was not compiled or run (no buildable project for this task).'

eval_feedback.overall: All expectations are substantive and accurately reflect the task requirements. The agent correctly identified the API migration (SaveBlueprint obsolete removal with correct replacement), understood the nuanced notification behavior (unpublishing some cultures raises ContentPublishedNotification, not just ContentUnpublishedNotification), and provided production-ready handler code with appropriate IComposer registration. The response included valuable context (version compatibility matrix, fallback APIs for 18.0.0, caveats about invariant content and mandatory languages) and was appropriately transparent about the lack of runtime validation.
